text.p: China set its 10th world record at the Asian weightlifting championships when Wang Yanmei snatched a world beating 112.5 kg in the women's 83 kg division, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
Wang broke the previous record of 110 kg set by Chen Xiaolian of Taiwan minutes earlier in the same competition.
China's Qu Lihua and Gao Shihong on Sunday set two world records in the women's 70 kg class of the championships in the southern Chinese city of Yangzhou.
Qu set a world mark when she lifted 130 kg in the clean and jerk, beating the previous record by 0.5 kg.
Teammate Gao snatched a world record 103.5 kg, topping the old mark of 103 kg set by China's Lin Weining.
Eight of the 10 Chinese world marks set at the tournament have been by the national women's team.
